reason: My guests find me on Instagram and Google Maps, I already post my specials there myself, and nobody opens a bar's website. Paying 25 € a month for a site is hard to justify in a year when I've had to raise prices twice to cover costs.
objection: It doesn't post to Instagram, which is where my regulars actually see the specials, so I'd still be doing that by hand and the website would just be one more thing nobody visits.
would_change_my_mind: If the same message also posted the special to my Instagram and Facebook, and kept Google Maps hours and menu right, so I'd stop updating three places separately.
